description: This is a Perl script implementing a minimal skeleton for a Git filter protocol version 2, handling packet communication between Git and the filter, including capabilities negotiation and command processing for 'clean' and 'smudge'.

methods.name: packet_bin_read
methods.description: Reads a binary packet from STDIN, returning a status and content.

methods.name: packet_txt_read
methods.description: Reads a text packet, ensuring it ends with LF.

methods.name: packet_bin_write
methods.description: Writes a binary packet to STDOUT.

methods.name: packet_txt_write
methods.description: Writes a text packet to STDOUT.

methods.name: packet_flush
methods.description: Flushes the packet stream by sending a zero-length packet.
